name: jev-status
description: After each turn asks TypeSafe Jev whether the task is done, needaction or failed, and whether the work may be deployed to production, development only, or not directly (Claude gives a second opinion when Jev is unsure), and shows both above the prompt

api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
api_key.description: From https://console.typesafe.ai/keys. Leave empty to use $TYPESAFE_API_KEY or ~/.config/typesafe/api_key.

toast.title: Toast each verdict
toast.description: Also show each verdict as a toast

deploy_check.title: Deploy check
deploy_check.description: Also ask whether the turn's work may be deployed: to production, to development only, not directly, or nothing to deploy

claude_below.title: Ask Claude below (% Jev confidence)
claude_below.description: When Jev's confidence in an answer is under this percentage, ask Claude for a second opinion on it and show Claude's answer. Applies to each check separately. 0 never asks.

claude_view.title: Claude's view
claude_view.description: summary: the review model reads what Jev read (prompt, final message, tool errors). summary-then-conversation: the same, and when that is not enough to tell, the session's own model re-reads the whole session (from cache). conversation: always the whole session.

review_model.title: Claude review model
review_model.description: Model for the summary review: an alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id. The whole-session review always uses the session's own model, so it reads the conversation from cache.

claude_on_jev_failure.title: Ask Claude when Jev can't answer
claude_on_jev_failure.description: With no TypeSafe key or a Jev error, ask Claude instead of showing the error
